name: Refillable Trigger Spray Bottle
shortDescription: Empty 750ml trigger spray for your refills. (Sample accessory)
description: SAMPLE ACCESSORY — replace or remove. An empty 750ml trigger spray bottle to fill from your Multi-Surface or Glass Cleaner refills.
howToUse: Fill from your refill jug and screw on the trigger.
Label the bottle with the product name.
safety: Always label refilled bottles clearly. Never put cleaners in drink bottles.
